VBO:0201097.summary: Affectionate and persistent in a local profile, seven-year-old Betsy offers a personal glimpse of the Puganese, a Pug–Havanese cross. The playful account portrays her greeting visitors with licks, seeking lap time and belly rubs, and joining her housemate Theo’s barking. It also describes her shaking a stuffed toy with gusto.
VBO:0201097.shortDescription: A Pug–Havanese cross; Betsy’s playful local profile describes lap seeking, enthusiastic greetings and stuffed-toy shaking.
